name: Moondream (small vision model)
summary: A tiny vision model that can describe a picture and answer questions about it, on this computer.
details: A very small vision-language model (about 1.7 GB) for quick, private descriptions and simple questions about pictures. It is far less capable than a large cloud model, but it runs on almost any graphics card and nothing leaves this computer. Runs in Ollama, which you install yourself from ollama.com.

capabilities.label: Answers simple questions about a picture

licence.name: Apache 2.0
licence.summary: Free to use and share, including commercially, with the licence notice kept.

verification.note: Atlas has not run this model.

instructions: Install Ollama from https://ollama.com, then press Install here (or run: ollama pull moondream).
Atlas can ask your own Ollama to download it (with your approval). Atlas cannot make a language model look at pictures unless the model is a vision model, as this one is.
